shared_elements: relief carving of an anthropomorphic figure occupying a roughly vertical panel
large headdress or head-covering mass at the top
concentric circular/oval ornament motif (eye or ear ornament) beside the head
curvilinear incised detail lines suggesting jewellery or garment bands
broad rounded lower mass (skirt/base) beneath the figure
justification: Both surfaces present a single frontal anthropomorphic relief figure filling a tall panel, with a broad head/headdress mass at the top flanked by a concentric circular ornament, curvilinear incised bands over the torso, and a wide rounded lower mass, which is a fairly specific shared scheme rather than a generic figure. The difference is that in B only fragmentary curvilinear traces and one ring motif are legible, so the seated posture, limb arrangement and the flanking scalloped/feathered fringe that dominate A cannot be confirmed there.
